title: Correct the analyzer lint-rule count in docs/coding-standards.md (claims 83, actual 79)

evidence.quote: a deliberately hand-rolled explicit list (83 rules in `analysis_options.yaml`)...

why: analysis_options.yaml's linter.rules block has exactly 79 entries (lines 21-99), not 83. development-guide.md's independent '~80 lints' hedge happens to be accurate; coding-standards.md's precise '83' is not, and this is the doc explicitly positioned as authoritative for the lint baseline.
recommendation: Change '83 rules' to '79 rules' at coding-standards.md:695, or make the count self-verifying by having Rule 0 tooling count the block.
acceptance_criteria: docs/coding-standards.md's stated linter.rules count matches `awk '/^linter:/,0' analysis_options.yaml | grep -c '^    - '`
